## NavigationMenu.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The open item's value, or `null` when every panel is closed. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the open item changes.
- `delayDuration` :: How long to wait, in milliseconds, before opening a panel on hover.
- `skipDelayDuration` :: How long, in milliseconds, the menu stays warm after a panel opens, so the next trigger opens instantly.
- `orientation` :: Lays the list out in a row or a column, and places the viewport beside it.
- `surface` :: The fill of the shared viewport.
- `gap` :: The space between the top-level items. @default 'gap-xs'
- `label` :: The accessible name of the navigation.
- `children` :: The items and top-level links.

## NavigationMenuContent.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The flyout contents, shown in the shared viewport while this item is open.
- `pad` :: The padding inside the flyout, above and below the content.

## NavigationMenuItem.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value this item contributes to the menu when its panel is open.
- `label` :: The default trigger label. Ignored when `trigger` is provided.
- `trigger` :: The button that opens the panel. Spread `props` onto your own button.
- `disabled` :: Disables the trigger and prevents the panel from opening.
- `size` :: The height of the trigger.
- `textColor` :: The ink of a trigger whose panel is closed.
- `children` :: The `NavigationMenuContent` for this item.

## NavigationMenuLink.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `href` :: The destination of the link.
- `current` :: Marks this link as the current page.
- `size` :: The height of the link, matched to the triggers beside it.
- `textColor` :: The ink of a link that is not the current page.
- `children` :: The link label.

## navigation-menu.ts

### `interface NavigationMenuContext`

Shared state between the navigation menu and its items, content and links.

- `uid` :: The menu's unique id prefix.
- `value` :: The open item's value, or `null` when every panel is closed.
- `setValue` :: Opens the item with this value, or closes the menu when `null`.
- `scheduleOpen` :: Starts the open delay (or opens instantly while the menu is warm).
- `scheduleClose` :: Starts the close delay.
- `cancelTimers` :: Cancels pending open or close timers.
- `orientation` :: List orientation.
- `surface` :: The fill of the shared viewport.
- `viewport` :: The shared viewport element, once mounted.
- `registerPanel` :: Bumps the measurement generation when a panel mounts or unmounts.

### `interface NavigationMenuItemContext`

Shared state between an item and its content panel.

- `value` :: The item's value, paired with its content.
- `contentId` :: The id of the content panel, used for aria-controls.
- `disabled` :: Whether the trigger is disabled.

### `const navigationMenuRoving`

Roving options for top-level triggers and links.
